problem: Visuomotor behavior cloning must represent multimodal trajectories without the instability of energy-based negative sampling or excessive single-step compounding error.
contribution: Conditional diffusion over action sequences, integrated with receding-horizon control and visual conditioning; CNN and time-series transformer variants have different inductive biases.
algorithm: Train a noise predictor by squared error between sampled Gaussian noise and predicted noise on corrupted demonstrated action sequences. At inference denoise a random action trajectory conditioned on recent observations, execute a short prefix and replan. DDIM reduces inference iterations relative to training.
observations: Recent low-dimensional state or visual observations; visual encoder extracts camera features once per policy query. Temporal observation horizon, prediction horizon and executed action horizon are distinct.
actions: Task-dependent continuous action sequences; position-control actions are particularly effective. The benchmark deliberately gives each compared method its best-performing action space, so an action-space-matched Explorer ablation remains necessary.
embodiment_and_data: Fifteen simulated and real tasks spanning robomimic Lift/Can/Square/Transport/ToolHang, PushT, BlockPush, Kitchen and additional real single/bimanual manipulation. Demonstrations include proficient and multiple-human data.
experiments: State and visual behavior-cloning benchmarks, multi-stage tasks, real PushT/mug/sauce tasks and extended bimanual examples. Ablations study action horizon, backbone, representation, training stability and pretraining.
baselines: Reproduced LSTM-GMM/BC-RNN, IBC and BeT; evaluate three training seeds and50environment initializations per seed in the tabulated simulation benchmark. Tables distinguish maximum checkpoint score from average oflast10checkpoints.

quantitative_result.evaluation: Three training seeds. Page7footnote reports that an evaluation-code bug used only22initialconditions for robomimic tasks instead of the stated50; the caption150trial count must not be treated as the actual independent denominator.
quantitative_result.secondary_latency: PDFp4§3.4:10DDIMinference steps yields0.1s onNVIDIA3080, not onNX

limitations: BC still depends on demonstration coverage. Iterative denoising is more expensive than simple recurrent policies; chunking cannot guarantee adequate reaction at high control rates. Transformer sensitivity and differing action spaces complicate attribution of gains. The primary PDF includes an evaluation-code caveat (page7footnote) about22rather than50initializations, which must accompany reported robomimic numbers.
hardware_adaptation: COMPARE a compact diffusion alternative toACT only after actualNX inference/VRAM/thermal profiling. Copy the observation/actionnormalizer and temporal horizon semantics with the checkpoint. Do not treat a3080latency as aJetsonmeasurement.
algorithm_detail: CNN variant uses observation FiLM conditioning of temporal convolutions; transformer uses observation cross-attention and causal action tokens. Inspected code explicitly normalizes observations/actions, samples scheduler timesteps and takes predicted actions starting at n_obs_steps-1, so temporal alignment is an integration contract, not merely matching tensor dimensions.
integration_contract: Bind camera and action feature order, fitted normalization, observation horizon, prediction horizon, action horizon and inference scheduler/steps to the artifact. Expire latechunks locally and retain robot-side permission/acknowledgment checks.
license_evidence: PrimaryGitHub metadata identifies MIT at the pinnedhead. Coreprediction/sampling code was read. Separate checkpoint/demonstration rights were not audited.
required_experiments: Same-dataACT comparison; matched action-space ablation; image/state deployment parity; measuredNX latency and stale-chunk behavior; checkpoint reload equivalence; heldout closed-loop task success rather than denoising loss.
difference_from_explorer: A strong policy baseline already providing chunked control; it does not supply cross-robot action compatibility, verified skillmemory or cause-selective repair. Adding these claims requires independent measurements.
